locales.simulation: 教学模拟，不会执行下方 Python 提交。每帧恰好算完一格，按 j 从左到右展示公式；Python 的 D 分支从右到左累加。小预设显示完整精确计数，不取模。表行是 s 开头已处理的字符，列是末尾排名 j，即该排列中有 j 个值小于末尾值（不是固定原始数值）。
locales.costs: n = len(s)。逐格直接求和的排名 DP 是 O(n³) 时间；累计求和后，处理 i 个比较的这一行耗时 O(i)，总 O(n²) 时间、O(n) 辅助空间。取模让每个存储的计数有界。教学表有 O(n²) 个格，并对 O(n²) 次操作保存完整快照，因此模拟的时间与存储最坏为 O(n⁴)，仅用于长度至多 4 的预设；它不是代码运行时内存示意。

locales.formula: I: nxt[j] = Σ dp[k], 0 ≤ k < j; D: nxt[j] = Σ dp[k], j ≤ k < m. Here m is the old row length, and 0 ≤ j ≤ m. An empty sum is 0.
locales.simulation: Teaching simulation; it does not execute the Python submission below. Each frame completes one cell, displaying the formula left to right in j; Python accumulates D rows right to left. These small presets show complete exact counts without modulus. Rows are the first processed characters of s; column j is the final value’s rank: j values in that order are smaller than it. It is not a fixed original value.
locales.costs: Let n = len(s). Rank DP that resums each cell takes O(n³) time. Running sums reduce the row after i comparisons to O(i) time, giving O(n²) time and O(n) auxiliary space. Modulus bounds stored counts. The teaching table has O(n²) cells and keeps a full snapshot for each of O(n²) operations, so simulation time and storage are O(n⁴). Presets are limited to length 4; this is not a runtime memory diagram.
